Bootstrap draws of a rating

Source: R/accessors.R
rating_bootstrap.Rd

The per-draw coefficients from a fit made with n_boot > 0: one row per draw and limb, with the limb's stage range alongside, in the shape apply_rating_interval() takes. Replaces bootstrap_to_table().

Usage

rating_bootstrap(x, successful_only = TRUE)

Arguments

x

A FlodeRating fitted with rate_optimise(..., n_boot = ). The other rating classes carry no bootstrap.

successful_only

Logical. Drop draws that failed or were rejected (default TRUE). With FALSE every requested draw is returned, with success and reason columns saying what became of it; a failed draw has NA coefficients.

Value

A data.table with limb, draw, lower_stage_m, upper_stage_m, C, a and n (plus success and reason when successful_only = FALSE). Errors, saying how to get one, if the fit has no bootstrap draws or none succeeded.

See also

apply_rating_interval(), rating_coefficients()

Examples

set.seed(1)
stage_m <- seq(0.5, 2.5, by = 0.05)
discharge_cms <- 5 * stage_m^1.6 + rnorm(length(stage_m), sd = 0.02)
fit <- rate_optimise(discharge_cms, stage_m, n_boot = 50L, boot_seed = 1L)
head(rating_bootstrap(fit))
#> Key: <limb>
#>     limb  draw lower_stage_m upper_stage_m        C             a        n
#>    <int> <int>         <num>         <num>    <num>         <num>    <num>
#> 1:     1     1           0.5           2.5 5.026513  3.269676e-03 1.596470
#> 2:     1     2           0.5           2.5 5.018405  2.894183e-03 1.598703
#> 3:     1     3           0.5           2.5 4.994507 -1.934379e-05 1.600895
#> 4:     1     4           0.5           2.5 4.987080 -1.924049e-03 1.601480
#> 5:     1     5           0.5           2.5 4.975609 -3.532390e-03 1.602635
#> 6:     1     6           0.5           2.5 4.931092 -8.918307e-03 1.609525
